annotations.title: Run a free Amazon brand, storefront & listing audit

description: Scans a brand's public storefront HTML (homepage + up to 2 key pages, robots.txt, llms.txt, JSON-LD schema, AI crawler access, untagged outbound Amazon links, Meta Pixel), checks pasted Amazon listing copy for FDA/DSHEA supplement and Amazon policy flags, evaluates break-even ACoS / TACoS / geo holdout readiness, and returns a score with the top 3 prioritized fixes.

amazonUrlOrAsin.description: Amazon ASIN or product URL for reference

listingDescription.description: Optional Amazon description or A+ copy

listingTitle.description: Amazon product title for FDA/DSHEA and policy checks

metrics.description: Optional unit economics and ad spend numbers

fbaFee.description: FBA fulfillment fee per unit in USD

monthlyAmazonAdSpend.description: Monthly Amazon Ads spend in USD

monthlyAmazonSales.description: Monthly Amazon gross sales in USD

monthlyMetaSpend.description: Monthly Meta ad spend in USD

unitCost.description: Landed COGS per unit in USD

unitPrice.description: Selling price per unit in USD

websiteUrl.description: Brand website URL or domain, e.g. https://yourbrand.com

name: run_brand_audit
